#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ask21k 00-bootstrap-scripts — ONE Workbench paste (确认粘贴)
# FIX vs ask21j: clock uses bash date -u +%s / date -d (NO py3.7+ datetime ISO parser).
# Real expiry → EXPIRED_AT_EXEC; date tool fail → CLOCK_TOOL_FAIL (not false EXPIRED).
# Creates /root/ask21k-host-replace-one/scripts mode 700; writes 7 paste files via base64 (O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW).
# SEEK_B=YES_ONE_RETRY_EXECUTE_WITH_STRICT_GATES · Owner REF=OWNER-B71-STAGING-INSTALLER-REPLACE-ONE-20261025 · EXPIRES=2026-10-26T09:50:00Z
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="/root/ask21k-host-replace-one"
SCRIPTS="$ROOT/scripts"
die(){ echo "ASK21K_BOOTSTRAP=FAIL reason=$*"; exit 1; }
[[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]] || die "not_root"
OWNER_EXPIRES="2026-10-26T09:50:00Z"
echo "CLOCK_NOW_UTC=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
echo "OWNER_EXPIRES=$OWNER_EXPIRES"
now_epoch=$(date -u +%s) || die "CLOCK_TOOL_FAIL now_epoch"
exp_epoch=$(date -u -d "$OWNER_EXPIRES" +%s) || die "CLOCK_TOOL_FAIL parse_expires"
if [[ "$now_epoch" -ge "$exp_epoch" ]]; then
  die "EXPIRED_AT_EXEC"
fi
echo "OWNER_CLOCK_OK=YES"
echo "CLOCK_FIX=bash_date_epoch_no_ISO-parser"

if [[ -e "$ROOT" ]]; then
  [[ -d "$ROOT" && ! -L "$ROOT" ]] || die "root_exists_not_dir_or_symlink"
else
  mkdir -m 0700 "$ROOT"
fi
chmod 700 "$ROOT"
[[ ! -L "$ROOT" ]] || die "root_is_symlink"
if [[ -e "$SCRIPTS" ]]; then
  [[ -d "$SCRIPTS" && ! -L "$SCRIPTS" ]] || die "scripts_exists_bad"
  if [[ -n "$(find "$SCRIPTS" -mindepth 1 -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)" ]]; then
    die "scripts_dir_not_empty"
  fi
else
  mkdir -m 0700 "$SCRIPTS"
fi
chmod 700 "$SCRIPTS"
mkdir -p -m 0700 "$ROOT/want" "$ROOT/out" "$ROOT/want/_recv"
chmod 700 "$ROOT/want" "$ROOT/out" "$ROOT/want/_recv"

python3 - "$SCRIPTS" <<'PY'
import sys, os, errno, hashlib, base64
scripts = sys.argv[1]
FILES = [
    '01-pre-ro.sh.txt|32de06cf8c8cb405087c2cf3c361f65548fee4cd88e0f3c160ae453a344999b0|',
    '02-receive-one.sh.txt|6b853bef03282d433cce6297f50b0b03e4a904da2c223353318604bdff910c91|',
    '03-verify-only.sh.txt|876bc9b25b0377e7e851c0d591d54101dfe3d5b96eae37663e50e761e789b9e9|',
    '04-atomic-replace.sh.txt|b639827a206fbc896a85b3beaa74c464f39e8e1dc4ae1eb5296b40389c3c1dec|',
    '05-post-ro-hard-stop.sh.txt|f1a33f13d971e515bdce35fadae0ba4b4ce01e28895e79ced93a350d0920b20e|',
    'lock_safe.inc.sh|c9512838a8187fa99d2a96cd72ccff7866882ff5ba0112f694e5c50faff839fe|',
    'path_bind_common.inc.sh|60e02358e99b53bb79c6f9fe265cc1c237dd4752ad45a38a0a88c0b338820fdd|'
]
for entry in FILES:
    name, want_sha, b64 = entry.split("|", 2)
    raw = base64.b64decode(b64.encode("ascii"), validate=True)
    got = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    if got != want_sha:
        raise SystemExit("SHA_MISMATCH %s want=%s got=%s" % (name, want_sha, got))
    path = os.path.join(scripts, name)
    if os.path.lexists(path):
        raise SystemExit("EXISTS " + path)
    flags = os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    try:
        fd = os.open(path, flags, 0o700)
    except FileExistsError:
        raise SystemExit("EXCL " + path)
    except OSError as e:
        if e.errno == errno.ELOOP:
            raise SystemExit("NOFOLLOW " + path)
        raise
    try:
        n = 0
        while n < len(raw):
            n += os.write(fd, raw[n:])
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    os.chmod(path, 0o700)
    got2 = hashlib.sha256(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    if got2 != want_sha:
        raise SystemExit("POST_SHA_MISMATCH " + name)
    print("WROTE", name, "sha", got2, "bytes", len(raw))
print("BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS_OK count=%d" % len(FILES))
PY
[[ $? -eq 0 ]] || die "python_write_fail"
echo "ASK21K_KIT_ROOT=$ROOT"
echo "ASK21K_SCRIPTS=$SCRIPTS"
echo "ASK21J_FALSE_EXPIRED_FIX=bash_date_epoch"
echo "ASK21K_BOOTSTRAP=PASS"
